get_exchange_rates.description: Get euro exchange rates against one or more currencies: daily, at the end of each month, or as monthly or annual averages, the latest few or between two dates. Each rate is units of the currency for one euro. Uses the ECB's reference rate for the currencies it quotes and, for about 110 more, the rate in the currency's own country, as the Bundesbank collects it (mostly end of month). No API key required.
